slides.heading: Q2 FY27 · STANDALONE · DMART'S OWN FILING
slides.body: Revenue ₹19,206 crore. EBITDA margin 7.3%, against 7.6% a year ago.

slides.heading: GROSS MARGIN HELD · OUR ARITHMETIC
slides.body: No price war. Stores two years and older grew 9.5%, against 6.8% a year ago.

slides.body: 518 stores now. Depreciation rose 26% and finance costs 87%.
